desc:
😁 Place down voxel building blocks and unleash your creativity! Build awesome creations, craft unique buildings, roleplay with friends, and let your imagination run wild! There’s no limit to what you can design in your own voxel world!

❓ How to Build:
- Open your Inventory
- Select a Block
- Click or Tap to Place
- Use the Pickaxe to Mine Blocks!

⭐ Like and favorite the game for new block updates every week!
💾 Want to save your creations? Use the Personal Worlds feature!

NEW UPDATE - ROLLER COASTERS:
- Build your very own roller coaster tracks!
- Exclusive Halloween Update, limited time!
- New Unlockable Pickaxe Skins!
- Day-night cycle feature!
